name: Gareb
overview: Gareb was a male warrior identified as the Ithrite and listed as the thirty-sixth member of "the thirty," an elite group of David's men. Beyond this designation, Scripture provides no additional details about his tribal affiliation or personal background.
namesAndTitles: The name Gareb means "scabby," a proper name recorded in 2 Samuel 23:38. There is no indication that this name was given by God or carries a specific divine significance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Gareb beyond his identification as one of David's mighty men. No further relational details are provided.
scriptureSignificance: Gareb's significance lies in his inclusion among David's elite warriors, "the thirty," highlighting his role in the military strength and leadership that supported King David's reign. His designation as the Ithrite places him within the broader context of David's loyal followers, contributing to the establishment of Israel's monarchy under God's providence.
